name: 2023-1c-parcial1
title: Drilling simulator: bits, soil layers and sonar
description: A vertical drill with interchangeable bits (soft, widia, diamond) hits a stack of soil layers (sandy, earth, concrete with resistance) that react differently to each bit; the student must replace the symbol-based ifs with polymorphism, remove duplication in model and tests, rewrite the loop-based depth/count methods with collection protocol, and add the rule that two contiguous layers cannot be of the same type.

design.notes: Two orthogonal kinds (bit type x layer type) are both encoded as symbols and dispatched in one 3x3 nested-if method, the soil is a heterogeneous Array mixing CapaDeSuelo instances with plain strings (stones), and the scan constants 7/10/50 are duplicated across three whileTrue: loops; the student must decide which axis becomes the receiver (double dispatch) and how the bit's broken state is modelled.
